payload.reason: The evidence explains that word overlap is used in the F1 score to account for cases where entities may be referred to by different names, thus avoiding false positives in detecting invalid questions.

claims.text: Word overlap is used instead of an exact match to avoid false positives when entities are referred to by different names.
Using F1 allows for flexibility in entity recognition, as it can match entities that are the same but named differently.
The choice of F1 over exact match helps in accurately identifying unresolved coreference issues in questions.
